name: diff-semantic-rename-matching
title: Match renamed containers semantically in the diff
description: Pair renamed ECUC containers in the diff so each rename is one changed row with aligned children, behind a setting and a toolbar toggle, with deterministic scoring and a performance budget.
creator: deviousprophet
notes: v0.6.1 Track B. Semantic rename pass in pairLevel after the identity passes: same parent, kind and DEFINITION-REF; weighted score (children 0.55, name 0.30, position 0.10, substitution 0.05), threshold 0.62 with a 0.08 both-sides margin; learned token substitution; parent-relative child pairing; rename-implied change marking; renamed marker, toolbar toggle, summary count; arxmlScope.diff.semanticMatching default on. Strict mode must reproduce v0.6.0 output. Ships with 11-04-validation-false-positives; shared release steps are in its implement.md section 8. Planning only - no src changes in this phase.
